title: The reminders control keeps its mode in five useStates (busy, confirming, needsEmail, refreshedFor, error; reminders-control.tsx ~:27-37): one ToggleStep union with transition()
evidence: widget-src/standalone/reminders-control.tsx ~:27-37 holds the toggle's mode in busy, confirming, needsEmail, refreshedFor and error, set beside each other. The H18e design note sketches the union: type ToggleStep = {step:'idle'; error?} | {step:'asking'; form; error?} | {step:'turningOn'; form} | {step:'turningOff'} | {step:'refreshed'; email}. On/off stays derived from the record, never in the union. transition(state, event), events: open, edit, submit, dismiss, onDone, onFailed(msg, needsEmail), onRefreshed(email), offDone, offFailed(msg). Table test per .claude/skills/untangle. Not needed by H18e/f/g; found in their design note.
